name: Compare directions while retaining a case study
description: Compares the same project across all directions and restores it after reload.
steps: In the Bold Creative Technologist iframe navigate to Selected work and open Mow Magic.
Choose Luxury Editorial then Expressive Digital Studio using the outer direction buttons.
Refresh the page.
expected: The studio direction and Mow Magic case remain selected after reload with hash studio/mow-magic. The full case study includes source implementation status and What still needs verification.

name: Filter projects and use mobile navigation
description: Uses mobile navigation and filtering while preserving contact details.
steps: Choose Expressive Digital Studio and Mobile viewport then Back to homepage.
Inside the preview open Menu + and select Selected work.
Activate Operations filter and confirm only the Mow Magic project article remains visible.
Open Mow Magic then use All selected work to return.
Open Menu + and select Let's connect.
expected: Nonmatching project articles are hidden. Project navigation and return stay inside the preview. Contact exposes mailto:tifflegg93@gmail.com without submitting anything, and outer controls fit mobile.

name: Inspect all case studies in both device views
description: Shows each original case study at both requested viewport widths.
steps: Choose Desktop + mobile viewport.
Use Page selector to inspect Mow Magic, Everfold, RunHouse Digital and Mow Magic Design System.
Inspect matching titles, role and implementation status in both iframes.
Choose Luxury Editorial, Homepage and Responsive viewport.
expected: Two labeled previews show the selected case study in paired mode. Responsive mode renders one viewport at available width. All original case-study sections remain accessible.

name: Inspect evidence and production isolation guardrails
description: Verifies evidence disclosure and guards against unsupported claims or production replacement actions.
steps: Choose Luxury Editorial and RunHouse Digital from the Page selector.
Expand Inspect implementation evidence inside the preview.
Inspect the Interactive estimator link destination without requiring private repository access.
Read What still needs verification.
Return to Homepage and inspect contact email. Inspect the comparison shell for publishing controls.
expected: Evidence expands to real GitHub source URLs. Frontend prototype and illustrative-pricing limits remain. Approved email is tifflegg93@gmail.com. The shell says Preview only and has no action to publish, approve or replace the production design.

name: Keyboard filtering and browser back
description: Exercises keyboard comparison controls and local navigation.
steps: Use keyboard Tab and Enter or Space to choose Bold Creative Technologist.
Select Homepage and Responsive viewport.
Inside the iframe use the keyboard to activate Business systems filter then All work.
Open Everfold and use browser Back.
expected: Focus is visible. Pressed states identify active direction and filter. All work restores four projects. Browser Back returns to the homepage within the comparison without opening production.
